claim_boundary: Demonstrates the reference implementation's defenses against the enumerated hostile-public-participation failures. It does not establish production Sybil resistance, Byzantine consensus across colluding principals, confidential public-worker inference, or formal OS/kernel isolation beyond the built-in subprocess resource boundary.

gates.claim: Any inherited-route removal/masking effect counts toward route share; stored roots are independently recomposed.
gates.name: route-and-composition-integrity

gates.claim: One active lease per identity, expiry exclusion/quarantine, absolute deadlines, and identity-distinct replicas.
gates.name: queue-hoarding-and-lease-defense

gates.claim: Submit, canary, rollback, close, and persistence mutations share one rollback-capable lock boundary.
gates.name: atomic-leverage-state-machine

gates.claim: Exploration/training promotion succeeds while coordinator training is replaced by an exception; independent replicas and verifiers carry the evidence.
gates.name: volunteer-compute-not-coordinator-replay

gates.claim: Workers derive requirements locally, bound downloads before parsing, use compact shards, enforce zero-memory truthfully, and kill active work after policy changes.
gates.name: payload-bound-resource-enforcement

gates.claim: Request/response bytes are capped before endpoint work; malformed stage evidence is excluded, quarantined, and auditable.
gates.name: bounded-wire-and-malformed-result-defense

gates.claim: Canary labels follow the committed class schema, non-informative batches fail, policy disclosure is hash-bound, and self-audit is forbidden.
gates.name: canary-and-disclosure-authenticity

gates.claim: Strict proof-carrying outputs, unpredictable audits, a 4,000-unit claim bond, requeue-on-fraud, and exactly-once terminal requester refunds.
gates.name: inference-proof-economics-and-refunds

gates.claim: Compatibility scanning cannot hide eligible work; architecture aliases and bounded numeric consensus are portable; share percentages are exact.
gates.name: heterogeneous-scheduler-liveness

gates.claim: Results survive network failure, expired envelopes do no work, remote coordinators require TLS or explicit override, and out-of-band fingerprints are supported.
gates.name: durable-delivery-expiry-and-trust-bootstrap

gates.claim: Concurrent first-run identity creation converges on one exclusively created Ed25519 key.
gates.name: atomic-identity-creation

verification_modes.inference: strict proof-carrying output plus secret bonded spot audit
